resources.string: Choose who finds you in search when they start a new chat.
Everyone on 2ecure finds you in search and sees your name and profile picture there.
You don’t appear in search. People who already share a chat with you still find you, and only they see your profile picture.
People who know your address can still invite you. You can change this any time in Settings.
Your choice could not be saved. Please try again.
This also covers your online status: with it off, nobody sees whether you are online, and you don’t see it for others either.
